description: Fine-grained authoring workflow states. Sealed packages still use KD-3 status values.

states.name: Idea
states.description: Problem or knowledge gap identified. No official package identity required yet.

states.name: Draft
states.description: Package skeleton and content authoring in a working copy.

states.name: Internal Review
states.description: Completeness, style, and checklist review by a peer or authoring lead.

states.name: Technical Validation
states.description: Schema, metadata, dependency, reference, integrity, and compatibility checks.

states.name: Knowledge Review
states.description: Domain/academic review of meaning, school consistency, and reference quality.

states.name: Release Candidate
states.description: Content frozen. Ready for release pipeline (checksum, notes, publication).

states.name: Released
states.description: Official Knowledge Database member. Artifact bytes frozen.

states.name: Archived
states.description: Not loaded by default. Identifiers remain reserved.
